_doc: Labelled retrieval eval set. Each case names the query and the document(s) that would have
PREVENTED a real failure. `expect` is a list of path substrings; a case is a HIT if any of
them appears in the top-k, and its rank is the position of the first such hit.
Two classes, and the split is the whole point:
incident  — phrased with the failure mode already known ('...WAITFORGAME hang'). These
measured rank 1-3 before any change. They are the REGRESSION guard.
decision  — phrased the way the question actually arrives ('which host block do I pick?').
These measured 0/2. They are the class the ranking work must fix.
Rule: never tune ranking until this file has a fresh baseline. A ranking change without a
before/after on both classes is unfalsifiable.

cases.query: non-resident costume model on-demand load hang crash STATE_WAITFORGAME refcount
cases.why: Incident 1. Hosting a character on a non-resident block wedges the load path.

cases.query: wardrobe outfit injected foreign model crash residency preload rule
how to ship a novel character model as a wardrobe outfit - new asset hash or existing name
cases.why: Incidents 2+3. Name-addressed delivery, not a minted hash.

cases.query: invent new asset name hash minted arbitrary hash registry validation collision
cases.why: Incident 3. A hash match alone is not evidence; every name needs a second witness.

cases.query: characters ship one block model LOD block chain finer rungs P001
cases.why: Incident 4. The single-block/LOD-rung constraint on cloning.

cases.query: wad_simulator is a nested git repo parent repo git status cannot see inside submodule
cases.why: Incident 7. Verified with the wrong tool; the lesson lives only in a transcript.

cases.query: skin_bytes weight-sorted duplicate slots merged positional comparison phantom mismatches
cases.why: Incident 5. Expected to MISS today - the knowledge exists only in session context.

cases.query: which host block should I pick for an injected character
cases.why: The exact question at the decision. Measured 0/2 before.

cases.query: how do I add a new asset without replacing an existing one
cases.why: The additive path (smuggler --extra-only --inject-extra) existed and was never found.

cases.query: what name should I give a new asset I am minting
cases.why: Would have blocked 0x50C0DE01 at the moment of minting.

cases.query: is this block safe to clone does it have finer LOD rungs
cases.why: The single-block criterion, phrased as the check rather than the symptom.

cases.query: I am about to ship an imported character in a patch WAD, what must I check first
cases.why: The pre-flight question. Nothing is decision-indexed for it today.

cases.query: I replaced a block with a bigger one, what else do I have to update
cases.why: page_count/packed_field recompute - the documented decompress-overrun class.
